items.context: User noted in R1 d2 that 'default should be more than 20s, restarting can sometimes take minutes.' We need concrete defaults for the consecutive-error threshold and max-age timeout. Agent-manager's StaleThreshold is 5 minutes for heartbeats.

options.label: 30 consecutive errors (~60s) + 30 min max-age
options.rationale: Tolerates restarts lasting up to 1 minute before declaring failure. Max-age of 30 minutes covers most legitimate runs while catching truly stuck ones. Both configurable via ServiceConfig fields.

options.label: 60 consecutive errors (~2 min) + 60 min max-age
options.rationale: More conservative — tolerates longer restarts and very long-running agents. Risk: slow detection of genuinely lost runs.

items.topic: Where to store per-run tracking state (consecutive errors, unknown-status count)
items.context: The staleness detector and unknown-status grace period both need per-run counters. These are ephemeral (lost on restart is acceptable). The question is where to store them — adding fields to the persisted Record vs. keeping a separate in-memory map.

options.label: In-memory map[runID]*runTracker alongside the store
options.rationale: Clean separation — persisted records stay focused on durable state (status, timestamps). Tracking state is ephemeral by design. Slight complexity: must create/delete entries in sync with records.

options.label: Add fields to the persisted execution Record
options.rationale: Simpler — everything in one place. Downside: ConsecutiveErrors and UnknownStatusCount are noise in the persisted JSON file, and they'd survive restarts which resets the semantic meaning anyway.

items.context: For Bug 2 (mapRunStatus), we agreed on a grace period before failing. Need to decide the specific threshold — number of consecutive polls returning an unknown status before transitioning to StatusFailed.

options.label: 5 consecutive unknown polls (~10 seconds)
options.rationale: Quick detection. If a status is unknown for 10 seconds straight, it's unlikely to resolve. Keeps polling responsive.

options.label: 15 consecutive unknown polls (~30 seconds)
options.rationale: More conservative — gives more time for transient status issues. But 30 seconds of unknown status is unusual.
